# Migration Requirements Quality Checklist: JetBrains IDE Support

**Purpose**: Test whether the requirements for moving ADP from Eclipse to the IntelliJ Platform are complete, clear, consistent and measurable. Focus areas: parity and byte fidelity with spec 001, removal of the previous host, and native host integration.
**Created**: 2026-09-24
**Feature**: [jetbrains-ide-support.spec.md](../jetbrains-ide-support.spec.md) (with [plan.md](../plan.md) and [contracts/](../contracts/) as supporting context)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Does the spec define which edit sequences and which maps make up the "reference results" of spec 001, or at least where that set is defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is it specified what "equivalent tests" means for FR-018, e.g. the same observable behaviour asserted, not the same test structure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is there a requirement for an inventory or traceability record that shows each spec 001 test has a JetBrains counterpart, so SC-007 can be checked? [Gap, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for a file that becomes uninterpretable while open, for example after a text-view edit, including how the visual view recovers when the text becomes valid again? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 - Does the spec state what happens when the same map is open in more than one editor tab or window at the same time? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are the name, location and collision rules for a new map created through the New menu specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is it specified whether choosing a folded node in the Structure view unfolds it in the file (an edit) or only in the view? [Gap, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are requirements defined for designer shortcuts that clash with the IDE's defaults (Tab, Enter, Space, Delete) outside the designer? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK009 - Does the spec say which operating systems are supported, and how shortcuts map on macOS? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is it specified whether the plug-in must declare an upper bound on supported IDE releases, or what happens with newer releases? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are accessibility requirements (keyboard-only use, screen readers) stated or explicitly excluded, given spec 001's out-of-scope list is carried over? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK012 - Is "whose content is a FreeMind map" defined clearly enough to decide borderline files (no XML declaration, BOM, leading comments, empty file)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "a clear explanation" for an uninterpretable file specified by content (what went wrong, where) rather than only by adjective? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is "the reason stated" for read-only files defined by where it appears and what it says? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §US2 AS-6]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is "legible" in FR-016 quantified (for example contrast ratio) and is "any font scale the IDE supports" bounded? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is "one named step" defined with the naming rule for undo labels, or a pointer to where spec 001 defines them? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is "the same file in the IDE's plain text editor" clear about whether text and visual views are shown side by side, switched, or both? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK018 - Does FR-021's "no network access" say whether opening a map's hyperlinks in the user's browser counts as network access? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is "a typical developer workstation" specified well enough (CPU, memory, IDE heap) to make SC-004 repeatable? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is "a developer familiar with IntelliJ IDEA or Rider" and "first attempt" defined with a sample size and a pass rule? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK021 - Are FR-001 and SC-001 consistent with the current product line, where IntelliJ IDEA Community and Ultimate are one distribution? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001, Spec §SC-001, Plan §Risks]
- [ ] CHK022 - Does FR-001 ("every IDE") agree with SC-001 ("at least two other" IDEs) and the assumption that Android Studio is expected but not tested? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §SC-001, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK023 - Do the no-trace exemptions agree across FR-017 (history and this spec), US4 AS-2 and SC-005 ("excluding this spec"), and the assumption that spec 001 is not exempt? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the Dependencies section still accurate now that the constitution has been amended to v2.0.0? [Consistency, Spec §Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is FR-006/FR-007 byte fidelity consistent with the host's known byte-changing behaviours (mixed line separators normalised on an edit, the "ensure line feed at end of file" user setting), or are those limits recorded as exceptions in the spec? [Conflict, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007, Research §R5]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the spec's product name for the repository and identifiers (`EtAlii.Adp.IntelliJ`) consistent with the no-trace rule, given the repository folder and remote are renamed outside the build? [Consistency, Spec §Dependencies, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK027 - Do the ordering constraints agree: reference results recorded before removal (FR-008), tests ported before Eclipse tests are removed (FR-018), and spec 001 artifacts rewritten at removal "not before" (FR-017a)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-017a, Spec §FR-018]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK028 - Does SC-005 specify the search itself: which terms (case, variants such as "EPL", "Equinox", "SWT", "GEF"), which locations, and what counts as a reference? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK029 - Does SC-003 cover every action type listed in FR-012, including drag and fold, with a stated reference result for each? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is there a measurable criterion for FR-015 (Structure view sync) and FR-013 (rebinding), or are they covered only by acceptance scenarios? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is US1 AS-2 ("the result is the same as in IntelliJ IDEA") defined by an objective comparison? [Measurability, Spec §US1 AS-2]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK032 - Are requirements defined for the upgrading user beyond their files, e.g. whether Eclipse keybinding customisations or preferences carry over or are knowingly dropped? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are the expected results specified when the plug-in is disabled or uninstalled with unsaved visual edits in an open map? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is the "IDE indexes or opens a very large map on startup" case given a threshold beyond SC-004's 1,000 nodes, or an explicit statement of the largest supported map? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are requirements stated for an external change arriving while the map has unsaved visual edits, or is deferring to the text editor's behaviour (FR-005) deemed sufficient? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Spec §US2 AS-5]
- [ ] CHK036 - Is the file encoding preserved explicitly for maps without an XML declaration? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-006]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK037 - Is the right to relicense from EPL-2.0 to Apache-2.0 (all copyright holders' consent) recorded as an assumption or dependency? [Assumption, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is the licence compatibility of the vendored example maps with an Apache-2.0 product confirmed in the spec or its assumptions? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK039 - Is the dependency on the Eclipse build still running to record reference results stated as a spec-level risk or dependency, not only in the plan? [Dependency, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Risks]
- [ ] CHK040 - Is Rider's file-view behaviour (Solution Explorer, split mode) captured as an assumption with a stated fallback if the designer is not offered there? [Assumption, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §R12]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Several items (CHK021, CHK024, CHK025) point at gaps the plan already works around; resolving them in the spec through `/speckit-clarify` keeps spec and plan aligned
